note: Recorded exceptions to World Design Rules 001 and 002 for tools/check_materials.py (WDR-007-C). Each names one material, profession or recipe, the finding it excuses (few_uses, few_professions, supplies_nobody, orphan), the reason and the rule. An exception whose finding no longer occurs is stale and fails the check. Hand-kept: only genuinely specialized materials are excepted (a feedstock refined by one recipe into a material that at least three recipes consume, or a component of one assembly); every other finding stays open in docs/systems/MATERIAL_INTERDEPENDENCY.md.

exceptions.reason: The sage's medicines are not a production input of another trade: they are bought by people of every profession when hurt (a guard hurt on duty, a miner, a hunter), from the sage with their own coins, to recover and keep working (NPCBrain._plan_heal). A functioning cross-profession relationship, not an isolated menu; no stockpile or artificial dependency is added.
